name: tools.settled/settled
title: Settled
description: Check an x402 endpoint before your agent pays it: does it answer, what it charges, did it deliver

tools.name: settled_status
tools.description: Free. Size and freshness of the x402 endpoint index and the on-chain ledger. Use when: you need to know how current Settled’s data is, or what the paid routes cost, before relying on any other tool. Not for: looking up a specific endpoint (use settled_check). No input.

tools.name: settled_peek
tools.description: Free, rate-limited. Coarse status and quality score for one x402 endpoint URL, from the index only (no fresh probe). Use when: you only need a quick yes/no on whether Settled knows the URL and its last status. Not for: deciding whether to pay — use settled_check (free, fuller) or settled_preflight (paid, fresh). If the URL is unknown, call settled_submit, then check again later.

url.description: Full URL of the x402 endpoint, e.g. https://api.example.com/search

tools.name: settled_submit
tools.description: Free, rate-limited. Queue an x402 endpoint URL for indexing. Use when: settled_check or settled_peek reports the URL as unknown or not indexed. Not for: URLs already indexed (it just returns their status) or non-x402 URLs. After: wait a few minutes, then call settled_check; the first probe runs within minutes. Idempotent.

url.description: Full URL of an x402 endpoint to add to Settled's index

tools.name: settled_report
tools.description: Free. After paying an x402 endpoint on Base, tell Settled whether you got what you paid for. Use when: your agent has just made a real USDC payment and has the transaction hash. Not for: endpoints you did not pay, or payments on other chains. Flow: call without signature to get message_to_sign; sign it with the paying wallet (EIP-191 personal_sign); call again with signature. One report per payment, one vote per wallet per endpoint; Settled keeps only per-endpoint tallies.

tx.description: Transaction hash of your USDC payment to that endpoint on Base, from the last 30 days: 0x followed by 64 hex characters, e.g. 0x3f9a...c21e

ok.description: true if the call delivered what you paid for, false if it did not

signature.description: EIP-191 personal_sign of message_to_sign by the wallet that paid (0x + 130 hex characters); omit on the first call to get message_to_sign

tools.name: settled_sellers
tools.description: Free. Sellers who proved control of the wallet their x402 endpoints are paid to, with their published profile and endpoint counts. Use when: you want a contact or docs link for a seller, or to see which sellers stand behind their endpoints. Not for: judging an endpoint’s quality (claims never change scores; use settled_check). Paged: limit (max 50) and offset, with a total.

offset.description: How many sellers to skip, for paging (default 0)

tools.name: settled_claim
tools.description: Free. For sellers: claim every x402 endpoint paid to your wallet with one signature, on every host, so your name, website, contact and docs show next to them (plus a 10-day Seller Watch trial). Use when: you operate x402 endpoints. Not for: buyers or third parties; only the payTo wallet can sign. Flow: call with wallet and profile to get message_to_sign and issued_at; sign with that wallet; call again with issued_at and signature. action=remove withdraws a claim (reversible by claiming again). Claims never change scores.

wallet.description: The payTo wallet your endpoints are paid to: 0x + 40 hex characters on Base, or a base58 address on Solana

name.description: Seller name to show on your endpoints, up to 80 characters, e.g. Acme Data

website.description: Your website, as a full https URL

contact.description: Where Seller Watch alerts go, strongly recommended: an email address (hello@example.com), or an https URL that receives each alert as a signed JSON POST (a webhook). Without one, alerts reach you only through the feed, your access log and answers to your own agent

docs.description: Your API documentation, as a full https URL

action.description: claim (default) or remove to withdraw an existing claim

issued_at.description: The issued_at timestamp returned by the first call; send it back unchanged with the signature

signature.description: Signature of message_to_sign by the wallet: EIP-191 personal_sign (0x hex) on Base, ed25519 (base58) on Solana; omit on the first call

tools.name: settled_preflight
tools.description: Pass required. The call to make right before paying an unfamiliar x402 endpoint: a fresh probe, parsed quote, payability, payTo on-chain history, seller integrity, the scout’s real-payment delivery result and a honeypot scan, as one signed answer with a recommendation (pay, caution or avoid) and reasons. Use when: real money is about to leave your wallet and settled_check was stale or not enough. Not for: browsing (settled_find_endpoints) or endpoints you already verified. After: compare pay_to and price with the 402 you receive, pay, then call settled_report.

url.description: Full URL of the x402 endpoint, e.g. https://api.example.com/search

force.description: true to probe the endpoint now instead of reusing a result up to 5 minutes old

pass.description: Settled day pass token, if you did not send it as the x-settled-pass header

payer_token.description: Optional. A Settled payer token (x4t_…) for your own wallet: when that wallet is the endpoint's claimed seller, the answer carries seller_alerts, your Seller Watch alerts

tools.name: settled_check
tools.description: Free: 25 calls/day per address, 300 with a payer record (free, keyed to your wallet), no daily cap with a pass. Check an x402 endpoint before paying it, from Settled’s index (cached up to 5 min): status, payability, latency, parsed price/network/payTo, payee on-chain history, the scout’s last real purchase, paying agents’ reports, seller claim, quality breakdown and risk flags, with a recommendation (pay, caution, avoid or unknown) and its reasons. Use when: deciding whether to call an endpoint, and for routine re-checks. Not for: a fresh probe right now (settled_preflight) or searching (settled_find_endpoints). If status is unknown, call settled_submit; after paying, call settled_report.

url.description: Full URL of the x402 endpoint, e.g. https://api.example.com/search

force.description: true to probe now instead of using the 5-minute cache; needs a pass

pass.description: Settled day pass token: lifts the free daily cap; or send it as the x-settled-pass header

payer_token.description: A Settled payer token (x4t_…, from POST /x401/token with your payer record): the free tier then follows your wallet, 300 a day, through any gateway

tools.name: settled_find_endpoints
tools.description: Free up to 50 calls/day per client (a pass allows 1,000). Live endpoints matching every word of q (in the URL, name, tags or description), best match first, then by quality, price, latency or payers; filter by network and max price; each with payability and delivery verification. Use when: you need an x402 endpoint for a capability and want candidates that are live, payable and, where possible, proven to deliver. Not for: verifying one known URL (settled_check). After: run settled_check or settled_preflight on the one you pick before paying.

q.description: One to four words every result must match in its URL, name, tags or description, e.g. weather forecast or gift cards; filler words (api, x402, endpoint) are ignored

network.description: Only endpoints on this network, as a CAIP-2 id, e.g. eip155:8453 for Base

max_price.description: Highest price per call in USD, e.g. 0.01

status.description: Only endpoints with this status; live (default) or any for every status

sort.description: Order of results: quality (default), price, latency or payers

pass.description: Settled day pass token: lifts the free daily cap; or send it as the x-settled-pass header

payer_token.description: A Settled payer token (x4t_…, from POST /x401/token with your payer record): the free tier then follows your wallet, 300 a day, through any gateway

tools.name: settled_seller_reputation
tools.description: Pass required. Everything Settled knows about one payTo address: the endpoints it is paid for, live/dead counts, price range, clone-farm and quote-only flags, on-chain settlements and unique payers. Use when: several endpoints share a seller and you want to judge the seller rather than one URL, or a payTo looks unfamiliar. Not for: a single endpoint’s status (settled_check). Input is the wallet address from a 402 quote.

address.description: The payTo address from a 402 quote: 0x followed by 40 hex characters (Base)

pass.description: Settled day pass token, if you did not send it as the x-settled-pass header

payer_token.description: Optional. A Settled payer token (x4t_…) for your own wallet: when it is this claimed wallet, the answer carries seller_alerts, your Seller Watch alerts

tools.name: settled_income_venues
tools.description: Free. Scorecard of bounty boards, task markets, audit contests and the x402 sell-side: verdict (paying / paying small / measuring / no payouts seen / unmeasured / closed to agents / defunct), agent policy, gating (KYC, human claim, self-custody wallet), open listings and on-chain payouts. Use when: choosing where an agent should look for paid work, or checking whether a venue actually pays. Not for: individual listings (settled_income_listings) or x402 endpoints (settled_find_endpoints). Poll settled_events for changes instead of re-reading this.

tools.name: settled_income_listings
tools.description: Pass required. Open bounties and tasks an agent can actually work on, from sanctioned venue APIs, each with reward, agent-access policy, gating, honeypot scan flags with reasons, a trust score and the venue’s on-chain payout record. Use when: an agent is looking for work it is allowed to do. Not for: venue-level questions (settled_income_venues). Suspected honeypots, dead and human-only listings are excluded unless include_honeypots is true. Before working one, run settled_income_check on its URL.

venue.description: Only listings from this venue, by its slug from settled_income_venues, e.g. superteam-earn

rail.description: Only listings paid on this rail, e.g. usdc-base

agent_access.description: allowed (default) for listings agents may take, or any to include human-only ones

min_reward.description: Smallest reward to include, in USD, e.g. 50

include_honeypots.description: true to include suspected honeypots and dead listings

sort.description: Order of results: trust (default), reward or recent

pass.description: Settled day pass token, if you did not send it as the x-settled-pass header

tools.name: settled_income_check
tools.description: Pass required. Fetches a bounty issue, repository or listing page and scans it for patterns used to bait agents (hidden HTML-comment instructions, prompt injection, credential requests, fork/star anomalies, dead or archived repos, reward anomalies). Returns trust, label and every flag with its reason. Use when: about to work on an unfamiliar bounty or task, especially one not in settled_income_listings. Not for: x402 API endpoints (settled_check). Treat a suspected_honeypot label as do-not-work; a clean result is not a promise of payment.

url.description: URL of the bounty issue, repository or listing page to scan

pass.description: Settled day pass token, if you did not send it as the x-settled-pass header

tools.name: settled_events
tools.description: Free: 25 calls/day per address, 300 with a payer record, no daily cap with a pass. Recent changes worth acting on: venue verdict flips, new suspected honeypots, settlement-integrity changes, newest first. Use when: your agent runs on a schedule and wants to react to what changed since last time. Not for: the full picture (settled_income_venues) or endpoint-level changes (settled_watch). Poll this instead of re-reading the scorecard.

limit.description: How many events to return, newest first, 1-200 (default 50)

pass.description: Settled day pass token: lifts the free daily cap; or send it as the x-settled-pass header

payer_token.description: A Settled payer token (x4t_…, from POST /x401/token with your payer record): the free tier then follows your wallet, 300 a day, through any gateway

tools.name: settled_watch
tools.description: Paid: $2.00 USDC on Base over x402 inside MCP (the first call returns the payment requirements; @x402/mcp clients pay automatically). Buys 30 days of monitoring for one x402 endpoint: probed about every 15 minutes, with a signed alert whenever status, payability, price or payTo changes. Use when: your agent depends on one endpoint and must learn quickly if it changes. Not for: one-off checks (settled_check). Give url to start or watch_id to renew; give webhook to have alerts POSTed, else read them with settled_watch_alerts. Returns watch_id.

url.description: The x402 endpoint to watch, e.g. https://api.example.com/search; required unless watch_id is given

webhook.description: https URL that receives each alert as a signed POST; omit to poll with settled_watch_alerts

watch_id.description: The watch_id of an existing watch to renew for 30 more days; give this or url, not both

tools.name: settled_watch_alerts
tools.description: Free. Everything a Watchdog has recorded for its endpoint since a given alert id: each change to status, payability, price or payTo, the endpoint’s state now, and next_since to pass on the next call. Use when: you created a watch with settled_watch and did not give a webhook. Not for: endpoints without a watch (use settled_check). Poll it whenever your agent runs; the endpoint is probed about every 15 minutes.

watch_id.description: The watch_id returned by settled_watch when the Watchdog was bought

since.description: Return alerts with an id above this; pass next_since from your last call, or 0 for all

tools.name: settled_weekly_report
tools.description: Free. The latest published Agent Income Report as JSON: which venues paid agents on-chain, worker wallets, honeypots flagged, x402 index health. Use when: you want the week’s summary, for a digest or a decision about where to look for work. Not for: live numbers (settled_status, settled_income_venues). Published Mondays; the window and ledger coverage are in the body.

tools.name: settled_verify
tools.description: Free. Pass any signed Settled response (attestation included) to recompute its hash and recover the signer; tells you whether it is authentic and unaltered. Use when: a Settled answer reached you through a third party, a cache or a log and you need to trust it. Not for: answers you just received directly over this server (already signed and fresh). Use the full response object, unchanged.

document.description: A complete signed Settled answer, including its attestation block
